evidence: Source review of the frozen bytes against row 19 (public sheet wording governs: network is public; the internal annotation's 'no network / no run-time install' is satisfied anyway). (1) solution/solve.sh: shebang '#!/bin/bash', 'set -euo pipefail', no CR bytes (grep -c $'\r' = 0), `bash -n` OK; `mkdir -p /app` then `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/` (same copy step as the template solve.sh) and `rm -f -- "$database_path" ...-wal ...-shm` so no database is shipped/kept; refuses a DB_PATH outside /app and refuses reset while a process holds the DB open (process scan only runs if a DB file already exists, so a fresh Oracle install exits early). No writes to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; grep finds no pkill, NODE_ENV, npm, curl or wget anywhere under solution/. No symlinks, node_modules or *.db files under solution/. (2) Entry and contract: solution/app/server.js is `require('./src/index.js')`; src/index.js main thread calls bootstrap.start, which listens on Number(process.env.PORT || 3000) on 0.0.0.0 and answers GET /api/health in the main thread before/without database work (bootstrap.js), satisfying instruction.md 'GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'. The SQLite work runs in a worker that inherits {...process.env, PORT:'0'} (so DB_PATH and NODE_PATH pass through) and listens on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral, proxied by the main process: one Node process serves UI and API. (3) DB_PATH: src/db.js `const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'app.db')` -> /app/app.db default, honoured when set (test.sh sets /app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db). (4) Self-contained: seed copied into the app at src/seed_data.json, byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c80...3740), read via __dirname, so /assets being unavailable at runtime and the /tmp/submission copy case both work; PUBLIC_DIR also resolved via __dirname. Dependencies are only express and better-sqlite3 (package.json 5.1.0 / 12.4.1, matching the frozen Dockerfile's global installs via NODE_PATH) plus Node built-ins; no install step; public/index.html loads only local /styles.css and /js/*.js (no CDN, no external backend). (5) Idempotent seeding: seedIfEmpty returns when users COUNT > 0; seeding runs in one transaction. (6) tests/test.sh and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template (cmp), so the stated contract (env -i with PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH; setpriv uid 65534; probe /api/health) is the template one and the reference code depends only on those variables. (7) node --check passes for server.js, src/*.js and public/js/*.js. Runtime evidence: raw-evidence-index artifacts' hashes verified, and all 12 matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen task bytes; results/workspace.json has 25/25 passed with page_errors [], including 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding'; server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (start + restart). workspace.cjs:16 launches `node /app/server.js` with a minimal env {PATH, HOME:/tmp, NODE_PATH, PORT:3000, DB_PATH:/tmp/hireops-workspace.db} and cwd /tmp, which exercises DB_PATH outside /app and a non-/app cwd. Adversarial checks: a broken reference that reads ../assets or the cwd for seed would fail under test.sh's /tmp/submission fallback - not the case here (all __dirname). A reference that shipped app.db or a stale WAL would skip seeding - solve.sh deletes them. Risk=true only because required runtime evidence is missing for this row's 'runs under the stated contract' half: no measured execution of solve.sh itself into a fresh agent image followed by the frozen test.sh launch (env -i + setpriv + chown in the configured verifier), and no Oracle/full configured verifier run; the scripted run does not show how /app was populated and is explicitly 'Not a configured judge run, Oracle grade'.
